content: .NET interface evolution rules (official docs): adding a member to a shipped interface REQUIRES JUDGMENT — default interface members (DIM, C# 8+) make it compile-safe but not all languages support DIMs and ref structs must implement every member explicitly; Framework Design Guidelines say DO NOT add members to a shipped interface (create a new interface instead); abstract base classes are the recommended alternative when default virtual implementations will be added later (dotnet/docs breaking-changes). For a public store seam meant to be stable, ship the full method set day one (D-11 full contract) and treat DIMs as an escape hatch, not a plan.
